name: Working with policies
purpose: People find a policy, read its definition, choose its state and values, edit raw policy files, and manage the definition files the policies come from: loading, downloading and inspecting ADMX/ADML files, products and support rules. Together this is the program's core job of viewing and changing Windows Group Policy settings.

name: Running the program
purpose: The program's start-up, shutdown and about screen, and restoring saved settings.
